concept.reason: Actual skull and body specimen photos with original anatomy sufficient.

scope: Original entire small biped: large canine-like teeth behind short beak and grasping hands, not isolated skull.

scale.basis: NHM genus estimate. Not measured length of AM4766 photograph or an assertion both named specimens same size.

specimen_basis: AM4766 actual fossil photo plus segmented CT anatomy eLife2021Fig1 and ESRF/P.Jayet skull photograph. SAM-PK-K1332 anatomy supports broader species reconstruction but is not AM4766.
diagnostic_targets: Small light biped with long balancing tail, substantial hindlimbs, relatively long nonweightbearing forelimbs and grasping hands.
Compact deep skull with short anterior beak and cheek tooth row; enlarged upper and lower caniniforms just behind beak, not horns emerging outside jaws.
Slight gape makes caniniforms readable; keep canine scale relative skull, not saber-tooth-cat overgrowth.
Hand digits: three main curved clawed grasping digits with two small reduced lateral digits; palm faces inward not flat-down pronation.
Entire body retained with neck trunk two arms two hindlimbs and tapering tail. No armour plates.
uncertainties: Wholebody proportions combine specimens and anatomical reconstruction; AM4766 figure is incomplete posteriorly and does not directly show complete tail.
Skin colour softtissue and presence of filaments unknown for this taxon; restrained smooth lowpoly skin avoids claiming feather evidence.
Caniniform function and dietary nuance not inferred from tusks alone; no sex claim.
AM4766 and SAM-PK-K1332 remain distinct specimens; no transfer of scale between them as direct measurement.
acceptance_checks: Whole small biped with longtail, grasping inward hands and no armour.
Shortbeak plus distinct caniniform pair on each side within jaw region.
Preserve enlarged teeth readable without giant tusk exaggeration.
handoff_contract: Same directory maker QA; COMPLETE fixedhash stops; root async backup localfirst integration; no maker upload cleanup.
runtime_profile: Static opaque palette-only GLB, no textures, skins, animation, compression or extensions. Independent QA required; browser/GPU/populated-scene review remains separate.

style.direction: Refined faceted original mesh with profile-built trunk, neck, tail and skull; restrained earth/olive countershading. No unsupported integument.
style.palette: Artistic terracotta dorsal, warm sand underside, dark keratin and ivory teeth; not known original coloration.
style.view_envelope: Whole animal four canonical views; close inspection limited by deliberately low-poly geometry.

origin: Root identity at intended hind-foot contact centre. Ground Z=0.
